What I do

Four ways my work reaches people

Speaker

Talks that connect the soil to the silicon — practical, human-first, and audience-aware. For agrifood conferences, universities, and innovation programmes.

Team training

Workshops and courses for agrifood teams that turn “AI curiosity” into confident decisions, from 45 minutes to 12 weeks, with BASIS CPD points.

Author

Field guides for growers and the people who advise them — plain about what a technology does, what it costs, and whether it earns its place.

Currently: The Precision Vineyard and Seed Quality Control, books one and two of the AI Fluency in Agriculture series, and Vertical Farming.
